basis.usd_per_gpu_hour: hardware amortized over 3 years at 24/7 plus power at $0.15/kWh: GB10 $4,000 + 0.20 kW = $0.18/h; Strix Halo $2,000 + 0.12 kW = $0.09/h. An assumption, not a price list.
basis.kv: per-token bytes from config.json: 12 full-attention layers x 2 KV heads x 256 dims x (K,V) x 2 bytes = 24,576, plus the sparse-attention indexer key cache 12 x 1 x 128 x 2 = 3,072, plus the MTP layer's KV 2 x 256 x 2 x 2 = 2,048. Fixed per-sequence state: 36 linear-attention (gated delta) layers x (48 x 128 x 128 fp32 state + (2x16x128 + 48x128) x 3 bf16 conv state) = 115,458,048 bytes. vLLM's own accounting on dgx: 19.63 GiB for 722,264 tokens = 29,183 bytes per token (spark-vllm.log, engine pid 74850).
basis.gpu_seconds: prefill: the tier's idle prefill time for the prompt (fixed_s + prompt / tps), capped by the observed time to first token, so queueing is not counted; decode: the integral of 1 / max(1, requests running) from the first token to the last, from the server's /metrics. A tier without a prefill model counts its whole time to first token.
